description: Use exact variable names from specification scenarios. When spec mentions agent_name, workspace_root, config_path - use those exact names in tests and production code. Example: agent_name = 'story_bot' (from spec), not name = 'story_bot'

do.description: Use exact names from specification in tests and production. Example: agent_name, workspace_root, config_path - all from spec

guidance.description: Production code uses same names as specification
Consistent naming across test and production

dont.description: Don't use different names than specification. Example: name = 'bot' when spec says agent_name (wrong)

guidance.description: Don't mix different terms for same concept

example: def load(self, path):  # WRONG - spec says 'domain_graph_path'
